title: FetcherWithComponents
summary: The result type of a Preact fetcher, including its bound Form.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body: Aliases TypedFetcher<RouteData<T>>. Includes optional data and error, idle/loading/submitting state, load, submit, and Form. T can be a handler function type or a result type.

sections.title: Usage and limits
sections.body: Create the value with useFetcher. Do not construct it by hand or assume data is present before a successful load. Its independent state does not represent page navigation.
